name: project-bootstrapper
description: Bootstrap a new project from an idea: select capabilities and deployment target, scaffold the infrastructure, and commit a runnable foundation.

interface.shortDescription: Scaffold a project infrastructure from an idea.
interface.longDescription: Takes a product idea and a set of capability selections — deployment target (Cloudflare Workers or Docker/Postgres), database, authentication, file storage, AI, landing page, legal pages — and scaffolds a committed, runnable project foundation. Supports Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 and Docker Compose + Postgres targets. Run this before Product Builder.
defaultPrompt: Bootstrap a new project from my idea.
Scaffold the project infrastructure and select capabilities.
